name: Consolidated Screening List (trade.gov)
summary: US export screening: one search over the Commerce, State and Treasury restricted-party lists (SDN, Entity List, Denied Persons, ITAR Debarred and more), from the International Trade Administration.

api_key.description: A free ITA subscription key (developer.trade.gov: sign up, subscribe to the Data Services Platform APIs product, copy the primary key from your Profile). Sent in the subscription-key header.

notes: Only active entries are in the API; for historical research use each list's own source.
A match is a prompt for due diligence, not a determination; check the entry's source list and its notes.
Paging: size up to 50, offset at most 1000, so narrow with sources, types or countries for broad queries.

endpoints.name: Search the screening lists
endpoints.summary: Restricted parties matching a name, address or country.

fuzzy_name.description: true for fuzzy matching on name; ignores common words like co, corp, inc, ltd, llc.

sources.description: List abbreviations, comma-separated: CAP, CMIC, DPL, DTC, EL, FSE, ISN, MBS, MEU, PLC, SDN, SSI, UVL.

types.description: Entry type: Aircraft, Entity, Individual or Vessel.

countries.description: ISO alpha-2 country codes, comma-separated; matches country, nationality or citizenship.

postal_code.description: Matched against the postal code field.

full_address.description: Matched against address, city, state and postal code together; overrides those four.

offset.description: Offset of the first result; at most 1000.

endpoints.name: List screening list sources
endpoints.summary: The source lists the feed covers.
